blocks.content:
Oath is administered by the President.

Tenure:
• Judges serve until the age of 65 years.
Oath is administered by the President.

items: Questions often test who administers the oath to judges: it is the President.
The retirement age for judges in this provision is strictly 65 years.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The oath of office for judges is administered directly by the President.
Judges hold their position and serve until they reach the age of 65 years.
